ghost: INTERPRETATION (with the exact basis above): dirac16complex00 is a commuting field with a first-order Lagrangian; at every real frequency half of its modes (Krein charge of the opposite sign) carry negative classical energy, and its energy is unbounded below. Components of negative classical energy are a ghost-like sector. With positive-energy components of real frequency only (for an extra-time mode: before its turning point a_*), w_eff(N1) >= 0 and w_eff(N2) >= -1/3 on the history b4 ~ a^(4/3) (theorem of section wkb): no dark-energy value under either normalisation from such components; reaching the Unite w0 with them needs a ghost-like sector larger than the positive energy. The exception is a condensate with lambda < 0 and m S > 0 (positive energy, attractive self-interaction; not a mode gas): its ratio w is below -1 exactly while lambda S/m lies in (-2, -1) (condensate_phantom_interval), and because w_eff(N2) = -1 + (beta/2)(1 + w) (condensate_observer_b4) the observer then reads w_eff(N2) < -1 as well; on the history lambda S/m ~ e^(-2 a4) drifts into that window toward the past (for lambda S/m = -382/441 today: from a = sqrt(382/441) = 0.9307 back to a = sqrt(191/441) = 0.6581, where its energy m S (1 + lambda S/(2 m)) vanishes). Its value -382/441 is CHOSEN, and no source of the history selects a condensate.

wkb.approximation: ADIABATIC (WKB) local plane-wave modes at a fixed hidden position: the warp sin^{1/6} z and tan z frozen (wavelengths short compared with the warp scale 1/H; in the variables chi = sin^{1/2} z b4^{3/4} Phi the terms 3 H gamma^(x0) and (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4) are absent exactly), the Krein charge of each mode an adiabatic invariant (|d omega/dx4| << omega^2); incoherent superposition (cross terms between different momenta average to zero over 3-space and the extra times; cross terms between frequencies average to zero in time)
wkb.component: rho = omega Q b4^(-3/2), p3 = k^2 Q b4^(-3/2)/(3 a^2 omega), p_t = -q^2 a^2 Q b4^(-3/2)/(3 b4 omega), p0 = 0, omega^2 = m^2 + k^2/a^2 - q^2 a^2/b4 (isotropic averages)
wkb.eps: eps = w_eff(N1) = (k_p^2 + (1 - beta/2) q_p^2)/(3 omega^2) >= 0 for real omega and beta < 2
wkb.mixture: w_eff(N1) = sum eps_i rho_i / sum rho_i, w_eff(N2) = w_eff(N1) - 1 + beta/2, w = p3/rho = sum p3_i / sum rho_i
wkb.theorem: if every component has rho_i >= 0 (Krein charge of the sign of omega), real frequencies, and total rho > 0, then w_eff(N1) >= 0 and w_eff(N2) >= -1 + beta/2 (= -1/3 on the history b4 ~ a^(4/3)) at every a at which these conditions hold (weighted averages of eps_i >= 0 with weights rho_i >= 0): no phantom, no crossing of -1, and no w_eff(N2) below -1/3 there. A mode with extra-time momentum q != 0 loses its real frequency past its turning point a_* (q_phys = q a b4^(-1/2) grows), where the theorem does not apply. Going below -1 + beta/2 needs a component with rho_i < 0 (negative classical energy: a ghost-like sector)
